text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Sipping matcha while admiring 
nature... There truly is no better way to 
spend one's leisure time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh—snatch!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My... what might this be? Where on earth 
did it fly in from—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—What was that just now?! Catching it on 
reflex like that is pretty amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That was my magic just now! Levitation 
magic to float this magic stone! ...I'm 
still training, though.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry!! I never imagined it would 
fail and go flying off like that... I 
wasn't being careful enough!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm so glad you caught it. Such 
incredible reflexes, as expected!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you know a lot about 
ninjutsu, right Grass-san? Between that 
and your bo-shuriken skills—you're just 
like a real ninja♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Perfect! Ninja Grass! You're free 
anyway, right? Have a match with us! The 
contest will be—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hide-and-seek!! Ninjas are supposed to be 
great at hiding, right! We're gonna expose 
you with magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you dodge our magic and catch us 
instead, you win! How about it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, my... Fufu. Very well, I shall do my 
absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I could hide here. And if I let 
them find me at just the right moment—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It would grant them a sense of achievement 
that their magic worked. That would be one 
way to guide them, however...

text_block_list.name: Grass's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Mmmgh, I'm way cooler! Let's have a 
contest, Big Sister!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Have a match with us!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Clear Nemesia Shadow! Mmmgh... I don't 
sense any presence at all...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We've searched all over the academy, so 
this is pretty much the only hiding spot 
left...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Caught you♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat—?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
G-Grass-san! When did you—?! There wasn't 
a trace of your presence or footsteps at 
all...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Muuuugh... To think you could outsmart 
Sweepy's magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're insanely skilled, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
One more time! Let's do it again!! Next 
time my magic is definitely gonna expose 
your ninjutsu♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will gladly accept your challenge. I 
shall slip past you with ninjutsu as many 
times as you like♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds, 
I spotted Grass Wonder deeply engrossed in 
a phone call.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —You really are amazing.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I heard from Father. You won another race 
over there, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Grass's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"That was a total breeze. Or would that 
have been too tough for you, Big Sister?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Fufu, I wonder about that. But—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "I am still stronger than you."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go thinking you can overtake me so 
easily."

text_block_list.name: Grass's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"! ...Ahaha, you'd better not let your 
guard down either, Big Sister! I'll catch 
up and pass you in no time, climbing way 
higher! Just you watch!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I shall look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(Just like during our childhood... when we 
played together, fiercely determined not 
to lose. As rivals—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finishing the phone call with her younger 
sister, Grass Wonder smiled warmly.
